quotes.text: Feed folder names trim whitespace and leading/trailing dots. Keep interior dots because they belong to hostnames and other useful text. Entry290 changed the old global-dot removal; current FeedUtils still has the anchored boundary expression. Test input whose meaningful punctuation is inside the name as well as at its edges.
